name: walk-right
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT RIGHT PROFILE view walking toward screen-RIGHT, nose/hands/chest and shoe toes face RIGHT, only one eye visible. Exactly TWO COMPLETE full-body WALK poses in TWO EQUAL cells left then right on a horizontal landscape 1536x1024 sheet. Frame 1: long open stride, one shoe at far RIGHT and other shoe at far LEFT. Frame 2: mid-step PASSING POSE with BOTH SHOES UNDER THE HIPS, knees close together, one lifted heel; feet NOT spread in frame 2. Frame 2 must have a clearly NARROW stance versus wide frame 1. Slack arms swing slightly opposite the legs. Same torso anatomical scale and local ground row. Complete figures around 760px high and generous clear margins, no cropping.
